info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Access Consent Management API
info.description: The Account Access Consent Management API enables financial institutions to manage user consents for account access in a secure manner. With this API, authorized users can revoke access permissions for third-party applications, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations. This functionality is crucial for banks and fintech services that prioritize user control over personal data. Typical consumers of this API include developers building open banking solutions that require seamless consent management processes.

delete.description: This endpoint allows the deletion of a specific account access consent identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that the consent exists before attempting to delete it, as attempting to delete a non-existent consent may result in an error.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for the deletion of the account access consent identified by RES-100045. It is intended to ensure that the correct consent is removed from the system as per the provided guidelines.

204.description: Request completed successfully; no content returned.

DeleteAispAccountAccessConsentRes100045R.description: A string representing the request body for deleting account access consents in the operation.

metadata.description: Contains metadata about the response, including identifiers and timestamps.

DeleteAispAccountAccessConsentRes100045R.description: Response schema for successful account access consent deletion.

correlationId.description: Correlation ID for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.
